description: This file defines TypeScript types, constants, and functions for configuring and validating an OpenShell plugin within a larger project. It includes schema validation, path normalization, and default configuration resolution.

methods.name: normalizeProviders
methods.description: Removes duplicates and trims whitespace from provider strings.

methods.name: formatOpenShellConfigIssue
methods.description: Formats validation issues into user-friendly error messages.

methods.name: isManagedOpenShellRemotePath
methods.description: Checks if a path is under the managed remote roots.

methods.name: normalizeOpenShellRemotePath
methods.description: Normalizes and validates remote paths to stay within managed roots.

methods.name: createOpenShellPluginConfigSchema
methods.description: Builds and returns the configuration schema for the plugin.

methods.name: resolveOpenShellPluginConfig
methods.description: Resolves and applies defaults to a given plugin configuration object.
